projects.name: jèrè
projects.description: Business management software for small businesses in Nigeria. Record sales, expenses, stock and the money customers owe you, and see your estimated profit. Live in early access: create an account and start.
highlights: Sales, stock, expenses and customer debts in one place
Estimated profit by day, week, month and year
Record sales, payments and expenses even when the internet is down
Cashiers record sales and never see costs or profit

projects.problem: Sales come in as cash, transfers and POS payments. Money goes out for transport, electricity, rent and stock, and customers take goods on credit. By night it is spread across a notebook, WhatsApp and memory, so many owners cannot say what they actually made.
projects.solution: Jèrè takes the cost of the goods you sold and your expenses away from your sales, so you see estimated profit and not just money collected. Sales, stock, expenses and debts sit in one place, and you decide what each team member can see.
keyFeatures: Record sales paid by cash, transfer, POS or on credit, including part-payments
Sell, take payments, add expenses and new products without internet; they are sent when you are back online
Stock list with restocking and low-stock flags
Daily expenses by category, with reminders for regular ones such as rent
Customers who owe you, with payments and reminders you send yourself
Receipts you can send by WhatsApp, Telegram, Text or any app you choose
Estimated profit for a day, week, month or year, compared with the period before
Which products make you the most money, and which sell below cost
A Business check-up of what is going well and what needs attention, with an optional Monday email
Count your cash at the end of the day and see if it matches your records
Business capital kept apart from sales and profit
Money you owe suppliers, tracked separately from profit
A simple staff pay list that adds pay to your expenses when you record it
Team access: invite a cashier by code and choose what they can see
A 4-digit PIN lock for the app
Download your records or delete your account yourself
Add it to your phone's home screen
roadmap: Early access: open for sign-up now
Lawyer review of the privacy page and terms
We will tell you before we start to charge

Fast navigation
